title: Microsoft signs four-country AI infrastructure contract with Nscale

sources.quote: Nscale will deliver approximately 104,000 NVIDIA GB300 GPUs in a ~240MW hyperscale AI campus in Texas, supporting the phased delivery of NVIDIA AI infrastructure services to Microsoft from Q3 2026.

explain: Microsoft contracted Nscale to deliver Nvidia GB300 GPU capacity across Texas, Portugal, the UK and Norway, including about 104,000 GPUs in Texas. The contract value was not disclosed.
